species.description: Every region, though scarce in the far West. Females are warm buff with red highlights and the same crest. Sings a clear slurred whistle; both sexes sing. Fond of dense shrubbery.
species.en_description: Every region, though scarce in the far West. Females are warm buff with red highlights and the same crest. Sings a clear slurred whistle; both sexes sing. Fond of dense shrubbery.

species.name: Tortolita Cola Larga
species.short_description: Small pale dove with scaly-looking plumage and rufous flashes in the wing.
species.en_short_description: Small pale dove with scaly-looking plumage and rufous flashes in the wing.
species.description: Colorado, California and Mexico City, in towns and gardens. The scalloped feather edges give a distinctly scaled appearance. Calls a mournful two-note no-hope from a wire.
species.en_description: Colorado, California and Mexico City, in towns and gardens. The scalloped feather edges give a distinctly scaled appearance. Calls a mournful two-note no-hope from a wire.

species.name: Azulejo garganta azul
species.short_description: Small thrush; males deep blue with a chestnut breast and back patch.
species.en_short_description: Small thrush; males deep blue with a chestnut breast and back patch.
species.description: Colorado, California, Washington and central Mexico, in open oak and pine. Hunts by dropping from a low perch onto insects. Readily uses nest boxes along fence lines.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, Washington and central Mexico, in open oak and pine. Hunts by dropping from a low perch onto insects. Readily uses nest boxes along fence lines.

species.name: Sastrecillo
species.short_description: Tiny plain grey-brown bird with a long tail, always in restless flocks.
species.en_short_description: Tiny plain grey-brown bird with a long tail, always in restless flocks.
species.description: Colorado, California, Washington, Mexico City and Baja. Moves through shrubs in chattering groups of a dozen or more. Weaves a remarkable hanging sock-shaped nest of lichen and spider silk.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, Washington, Mexico City and Baja. Moves through shrubs in chattering groups of a dozen or more. Weaves a remarkable hanging sock-shaped nest of lichen and spider silk.

species.name: Rascador Californiano
species.short_description: Plain warm-brown towhee with a rusty undertail and no markings.
species.en_short_description: Plain warm-brown towhee with a rusty undertail and no markings.
species.description: California and Baja. Almost featureless, which is itself the identification. Scratches in leaf litter beneath garden shrubs. Gives a sharp metallic chink call and a squealing duet.
species.en_description: California and Baja. Almost featureless, which is itself the identification. Scratches in leaf litter beneath garden shrubs. Gives a sharp metallic chink call and a squealing duet.

species.name: Jilguero canario
species.short_description: Small finch; breeding males bright lemon with a black cap and wings.
species.en_short_description: Small finch; breeding males bright lemon with a black cap and wings.
species.description: Colorado, California, Washington, New York and Baja. Winter birds are drab olive-buff. Flies with a bounding roll while calling per-chick-o-ree. Feeds on thistle and sunflower heads.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, Washington, New York and Baja. Winter birds are drab olive-buff. Flies with a bounding roll while calling per-chick-o-ree. Feeds on thistle and sunflower heads.

species.name: Carpintero velloso-menor
species.short_description: Small black-and-white woodpecker with a white back and a stubby bill.
species.en_short_description: Small black-and-white woodpecker with a white back and a stubby bill.
species.description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York. The smallest woodpecker here; the very short bill separates it from the Hairy Woodpecker. Males show a red patch on the nape.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York. The smallest woodpecker here; the very short bill separates it from the Hairy Woodpecker. Males show a red patch on the nape.

species.name: Paloma Alas Blancas
species.short_description: Grey dove with a bold white wing stripe and a blue eye-ring.
species.en_short_description: Grey dove with a bold white wing stripe and a blue eye-ring.
species.description: Every region. The white wing edge shows as a crescent in flight and a stripe at rest. Calls a rhythmic phrase often rendered who-cooks-for-you. Expanding steadily northward.
species.en_description: Every region. The white wing edge shows as a crescent in flight and a stripe at rest. Calls a rhythmic phrase often rendered who-cooks-for-you. Expanding steadily northward.

species.name: Zambullidor pico grueso
species.short_description: Small brown diving bird with a thick pale bill and no visible tail.
species.en_short_description: Small brown diving bird with a thick pale bill and no visible tail.
species.description: Every region on ponds and marsh. Sinks quietly rather than flying when disturbed. Breeding adults show a black throat and a dark ring on the bill. Gives a whinnying series of calls.
species.en_description: Every region on ponds and marsh. Sinks quietly rather than flying when disturbed. Breeding adults show a black throat and a dark ring on the bill. Gives a whinnying series of calls.

species.name: Saltapared cola larga
species.short_description: Slim grey-brown wren with a bold white eyebrow and a long barred tail.
species.en_short_description: Slim grey-brown wren with a bold white eyebrow and a long barred tail.
species.description: Colorado, California, Washington, Mexico City and Baja. Flicks the long tail from side to side. The white supercilium is the field mark. Sings a variable buzzy, trilling song from cover.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, Washington, Mexico City and Baja. Flicks the long tail from side to side. The white supercilium is the field mark. Sings a variable buzzy, trilling song from cover.

species.name: Golondrina tijereta
species.short_description: Steel-blue swallow with a rusty throat and deeply forked streaming tail.
species.en_short_description: Steel-blue swallow with a rusty throat and deeply forked streaming tail.
species.description: Every region. The only local swallow with long tail streamers. Builds a mud cup on a beam or under a bridge. Skims low over fields and water catching insects.
species.en_description: Every region. The only local swallow with long tail streamers. Builds a mud cup on a beam or under a bridge. Skims low over fields and water catching insects.

species.name: Martín pescador norteño
species.short_description: Big-headed blue-grey bird with a shaggy crest and a heavy dagger bill.
species.en_short_description: Big-headed blue-grey bird with a shaggy crest and a heavy dagger bill.
species.description: Every region along water. Hovers then plunges headfirst for fish. Females have an extra rusty belly band, unusual among birds. Announces itself with a loud dry rattle.
species.en_description: Every region along water. Hovers then plunges headfirst for fish. Females have an extra rusty belly band, unusual among birds. Announces itself with a loud dry rattle.

species.name: Mosquero cardenal
species.short_description: Small flycatcher; males brilliant scarlet with a dark brown back and mask.
species.en_short_description: Small flycatcher; males brilliant scarlet with a dark brown back and mask.
species.description: Colorado, California, Washington, Mexico City and Baja. Males are among the most vivid birds in the region. Sallies from a low perch over open ground, often near water.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, Washington, Mexico City and Baja. Males are among the most vivid birds in the region. Sallies from a low perch over open ground, often near water.

species.name: Chinito
species.short_description: Sleek fawn bird with a crest, black mask and red wax droplets on the wing.
species.en_short_description: Sleek fawn bird with a crest, black mask and red wax droplets on the wing.
species.description: Every region. Travels in tight flocks that strip fruiting trees. High thin trilling calls announce them before they are seen. Yellow-tipped tail and silky plumage are distinctive.
species.en_description: Every region. Travels in tight flocks that strip fruiting trees. High thin trilling calls announce them before they are seen. Yellow-tipped tail and silky plumage are distinctive.

species.name: Aguililla cola roja
species.short_description: Broad-winged buteo with a brick-red tail and a dark belly band.
species.en_short_description: Broad-winged buteo with a brick-red tail and a dark belly band.
species.description: The most-observed raptor in all six regions, on almost every highway pole. Adults show the rufous tail from above; juveniles have a brown barred tail. Soars in wide circles with wings held flat.
species.en_description: The most-observed raptor in all six regions, on almost every highway pole. Adults show the rufous tail from above; juveniles have a brown barred tail. Soars in wide circles with wings held flat.

species.name: Zopilote aura
species.short_description: Dark soaring scavenger with a bare red head and silvery trailing wing edges.
species.en_short_description: Dark soaring scavenger with a bare red head and silvery trailing wing edges.
species.description: Every region. Holds its wings in a shallow V and teeters constantly, which identifies it at any distance. Finds carrion by smell, unusual among birds. Never flaps much.
species.en_description: Every region. Holds its wings in a shallow V and teeters constantly, which identifies it at any distance. Finds carrion by smell, unusual among birds. Never flaps much.

species.name: Águila Pescadora
species.short_description: White-bellied fish hawk with a dark eye stripe and crooked wings.
species.en_short_description: White-bellied fish hawk with a dark eye stripe and crooked wings.
species.description: Every region, always near water. Hovers then plunges feet-first for fish, carrying them head-forward. Builds huge stick nests on poles and platforms. Wings kink at the wrist in flight.
species.en_description: Every region, always near water. Hovers then plunges feet-first for fish, carrying them head-forward. Builds huge stick nests on poles and platforms. Wings kink at the wrist in flight.

species.name: Cernícalo americano
species.short_description: Tiny colourful falcon with two black facial stripes and a rusty back.
species.en_short_description: Tiny colourful falcon with two black facial stripes and a rusty back.
species.description: Every region. Males have blue-grey wings; both sexes hover over field edges or pump the tail on a wire. The smallest North American falcon, and the most likely one over farmland.
species.en_description: Every region. Males have blue-grey wings; both sexes hover over field edges or pump the tail on a wire. The smallest North American falcon, and the most likely one over farmland.

species.name: Águila cabeza blanca
species.short_description: Huge dark eagle with a white head and tail as an adult.
species.en_short_description: Huge dark eagle with a white head and tail as an adult.
species.description: Five regions and recovering strongly. Immatures are mottled brown-and-white for four years and are often misidentified. Soars on flat plank-like wings; steals fish from Ospreys.
species.en_description: Five regions and recovering strongly. Immatures are mottled brown-and-white for four years and are often misidentified. Soars on flat plank-like wings; steals fish from Ospreys.

species.name: Gavilán de Cooper
species.short_description: Medium accipiter with short rounded wings, a long tail and a squared dark cap.
species.en_short_description: Medium accipiter with short rounded wings, a long tail and a squared dark cap.
species.description: Every region, and increasingly a suburban bird hunting feeder flocks. Larger and larger-headed than a Sharp-shinned Hawk, with a rounded rather than square tail tip. Flies flap-flap-glide.
species.en_description: Every region, and increasingly a suburban bird hunting feeder flocks. Larger and larger-headed than a Sharp-shinned Hawk, with a rounded rather than square tail tip. Flies flap-flap-glide.

species.name: Búho cornudo
species.short_description: Big barrel-shaped owl with wide-set ear tufts and a white throat bib.
species.en_short_description: Big barrel-shaped owl with wide-set ear tufts and a white throat bib.
species.description: Every region. The deep rhythmic hooting is the classic night owl sound. Hunts everything from mice to skunks. Nests very early, often in an old hawk or heron nest.
species.en_description: Every region. The deep rhythmic hooting is the classic night owl sound. Hunts everything from mice to skunks. Nests very early, often in an old hawk or heron nest.

species.name: Aguililla rojinegra
species.short_description: Dark chocolate hawk with rufous shoulders and a white-tipped black tail.
species.en_short_description: Dark chocolate hawk with rufous shoulders and a white-tipped black tail.
species.description: Colorado, California, Washington, Mexico City and Baja. Hunts cooperatively in family groups, unusual among raptors, and perches stacked on top of one another on poles.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, Washington, Mexico City and Baja. Hunts cooperatively in family groups, unusual among raptors, and perches stacked on top of one another on poles.

species.name: Aguililla pecho rojo
species.short_description: Boldly barred rufous-breasted hawk with checkered black-and-white wings.
species.en_short_description: Boldly barred rufous-breasted hawk with checkered black-and-white wings.
species.description: Every region, in wooded creeks and suburbs. The rusty barred underparts and translucent crescents near the wingtips are diagnostic. Screams a repeated shrill kee-ah, often mimicked by jays.
species.en_description: Every region, in wooded creeks and suburbs. The rusty barred underparts and translucent crescents near the wingtips are diagnostic. Screams a repeated shrill kee-ah, often mimicked by jays.

species.name: Gavilán rastrero
species.short_description: Slim long-tailed hawk with a white rump patch, coursing low over marsh.
species.en_short_description: Slim long-tailed hawk with a white rump patch, coursing low over marsh.
species.description: Every region. Flies with wings in a V, tilting like a vulture but far slimmer. Males pale grey, females brown; both show the white rump. Owl-like facial disc helps it hunt by ear.
species.en_description: Every region. Flies with wings in a V, tilting like a vulture but far slimmer. Males pale grey, females brown; both show the white rump. Owl-like facial disc helps it hunt by ear.

species.name: Carancho
species.short_description: Long-legged black-and-white falcon relative with a red face and heavy pale bill.
species.en_short_description: Long-legged black-and-white falcon relative with a red face and heavy pale bill.
species.description: Every region, though scarce north of Mexico. Walks confidently on the ground scavenging, unlike any true falcon. The black cap, white throat and bare red skin are unmistakable.
species.en_description: Every region, though scarce north of Mexico. Walks confidently on the ground scavenging, unlike any true falcon. The black cap, white throat and bare red skin are unmistakable.

species.name: Búho Barrado
species.short_description: Round-headed brown owl with vertical belly streaks and dark eyes.
species.en_short_description: Round-headed brown owl with vertical belly streaks and dark eyes.
species.description: California, Washington and New York, expanding west where it displaces the Spotted Owl. Calls a rhythmic eight-note who-cooks-for-you. No ear tufts and dark, not yellow, eyes.
species.en_description: California, Washington and New York, expanding west where it displaces the Spotted Owl. Calls a rhythmic eight-note who-cooks-for-you. No ear tufts and dark, not yellow, eyes.

species.name: Halcón Peregrino
species.short_description: Powerful slate-backed falcon with a thick black moustache mark.
species.en_short_description: Powerful slate-backed falcon with a thick black moustache mark.
species.description: Every region, nesting on cliffs and city towers. The fastest animal alive in a hunting stoop. Pointed swept-back wings and rapid stiff wingbeats separate it from any hawk.
species.en_description: Every region, nesting on cliffs and city towers. The fastest animal alive in a hunting stoop. Pointed swept-back wings and rapid stiff wingbeats separate it from any hawk.

species.name: Aguililla de Swainson
species.short_description: Slim buteo with a dark brown bib, white throat and pointed wings held in a V.
species.en_short_description: Slim buteo with a dark brown bib, white throat and pointed wings held in a V.
species.description: Every region in summer. A grassland hawk that migrates to Argentina, gathering in enormous kettles in autumn. The dark chest against a pale belly is the reverse of a Red-tailed Hawk.
species.en_description: Every region in summer. A grassland hawk that migrates to Argentina, gathering in enormous kettles in autumn. The dark chest against a pale belly is the reverse of a Red-tailed Hawk.

species.name: Halcón esmerejón
species.short_description: Small dark compact falcon with heavily streaked underparts and a banded tail.
species.en_short_description: Small dark compact falcon with heavily streaked underparts and a banded tail.
species.description: Every region. Stockier and darker than a kestrel, without facial stripes, and hunts in fast direct dashes rather than hovering. Takes small birds in level pursuit.
species.en_description: Every region. Stockier and darker than a kestrel, without facial stripes, and hunts in fast direct dashes rather than hovering. Takes small birds in level pursuit.

species.name: Gavilán Pecho Canela
species.short_description: Small accipiter with a square-tipped tail and a proportionally tiny head.
species.en_short_description: Small accipiter with a square-tipped tail and a proportionally tiny head.
species.description: Every region, in woodland and at winter feeders. Smaller than Cooper's Hawk with a square rather than rounded tail and a head that barely projects in flight.
species.en_description: Every region, in woodland and at winter feeders. Smaller than Cooper's Hawk with a square rather than rounded tail and a head that barely projects in flight.

species.name: Aguililla Alas Anchas
species.short_description: Compact buteo with a boldly black-and-white banded tail and rufous barred breast.
species.en_short_description: Compact buteo with a boldly black-and-white banded tail and rufous barred breast.
species.description: Every region on migration, when thousands stream south in dense kettles. Smaller and chunkier than a Red-tailed Hawk. Whistles a thin two-note kee-eee from forest canopy.
species.en_description: Every region on migration, when thousands stream south in dense kettles. Smaller and chunkier than a Red-tailed Hawk. Whistles a thin two-note kee-eee from forest canopy.

species.name: Águila real
species.short_description: Very large dark eagle with a golden nape and wings held in a slight V.
species.en_short_description: Very large dark eagle with a golden nape and wings held in a slight V.
species.description: Five regions, in open and mountainous country. Uniformly dark as an adult, unlike the white-headed Bald Eagle. Soars for long periods without flapping over ridges and canyons.
species.en_description: Five regions, in open and mountainous country. Uniformly dark as an adult, unlike the white-headed Bald Eagle. Soars for long periods without flapping over ridges and canyons.

species.name: Tecolote llanero
species.short_description: Small long-legged brown owl that stands upright at the mouth of a burrow.
species.en_short_description: Small long-legged brown owl that stands upright at the mouth of a burrow.
species.description: Every region, in prairie dog towns and open grassland. The only local owl that lives underground, usually in a borrowed burrow. Bobs and bows when watched. Active by day.
species.en_description: Every region, in prairie dog towns and open grassland. The only local owl that lives underground, usually in a borrowed burrow. Bobs and bows when watched. Active by day.

species.name: Milano cola blanca
species.short_description: Pale grey kite with black shoulder patches and a white tail, hovering over grass.
species.en_short_description: Pale grey kite with black shoulder patches and a white tail, hovering over grass.
species.description: Colorado, California, Washington, Mexico City and Baja. Hovers persistently on raised wings before dropping onto voles — the only local raptor that hunts this way so consistently.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, Washington, Mexico City and Baja. Hovers persistently on raised wings before dropping onto voles — the only local raptor that hunts this way so consistently.

species.name: lechuza común americana
species.short_description: Pale owl with a white heart-shaped face and no ear tufts.
species.en_short_description: Pale owl with a white heart-shaped face and no ear tufts.
species.description: Every region. Ghostly white below when caught in headlights. Screams a harsh rasping shriek rather than hooting. Nests in barns, silos, palms and cliff cavities.
species.en_description: Every region. Ghostly white below when caught in headlights. Screams a harsh rasping shriek rather than hooting. Nests in barns, silos, palms and cliff cavities.

species.name: Tecolote del Oeste
species.short_description: Small grey ear-tufted owl with yellow eyes and a dark bill.
species.en_short_description: Small grey ear-tufted owl with yellow eyes and a dark bill.
species.description: Colorado, California, Washington, Mexico City and Baja. Gives an accelerating bouncing-ball series of hollow notes. Roosts pressed against a trunk where its bark pattern hides it.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, Washington, Mexico City and Baja. Gives an accelerating bouncing-ball series of hollow notes. Roosts pressed against a trunk where its bark pattern hides it.

species.name: Aguililla real
species.short_description: Very large pale buteo with rusty legs forming a dark V against a white belly.
species.en_short_description: Very large pale buteo with rusty legs forming a dark V against a white belly.
species.description: Five regions, in open prairie and sagebrush. The biggest North American buteo, with a gaping yellow mouth line. The rufous leggings are the field mark on light-morph birds.
species.en_description: Five regions, in open prairie and sagebrush. The biggest North American buteo, with a gaping yellow mouth line. The rufous leggings are the field mark on light-morph birds.

species.name: Aguililla aura
species.short_description: Blackish hawk with a broad white tail band that flies like a Turkey Vulture.
species.en_short_description: Blackish hawk with a broad white tail band that flies like a Turkey Vulture.
species.description: Colorado, California, Mexico City and Baja. Deliberately mimics a Turkey Vulture, teetering on a V of wings, so prey ignores it until it strikes. Look for the banded tail and yellow cere.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, Mexico City and Baja. Deliberately mimics a Turkey Vulture, teetering on a V of wings, so prey ignores it until it strikes. Look for the banded tail and yellow cere.

species.name: Aguililla ártica
species.short_description: Arctic buteo with a dark belly patch, black carpal marks and a white tail base.
species.en_short_description: Arctic buteo with a dark belly patch, black carpal marks and a white tail base.
species.description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York in winter only. Hovers more than other buteos. Feathered legs to the toes. Perches on surprisingly thin twigs at treetops.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York in winter only. Hovers more than other buteos. Feathered legs to the toes. Perches on surprisingly thin twigs at treetops.

species.name: Tecolote del Este
species.short_description: Small ear-tufted owl with yellow eyes, in grey or rufous morphs.
species.en_short_description: Small ear-tufted owl with yellow eyes, in grey or rufous morphs.
species.description: Colorado and New York. Gives an eerie descending whinny and a soft trill rather than the western species' bouncing series. Both colour morphs occur in the same woods.
species.en_description: Colorado and New York. Gives an eerie descending whinny and a soft trill rather than the western species' bouncing series. Both colour morphs occur in the same woods.

species.name: Zopilote común
species.short_description: Stocky black scavenger with a bare grey head and short tail, showing white wingtip patches.
species.en_short_description: Stocky black scavenger with a bare grey head and short tail, showing white wingtip patches.
species.description: Colorado, California, New York and Mexico City, expanding north. Flaps more often than a Turkey Vulture and holds its wings flatter. The pale primary patches near the wingtips are diagnostic.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, New York and Mexico City, expanding north. Flaps more often than a Turkey Vulture and holds its wings flatter. The pale primary patches near the wingtips are diagnostic.

species.name: Halcón mexicano
species.short_description: Sandy-brown falcon with a narrow moustache and dark axillary patches.
species.en_short_description: Sandy-brown falcon with a narrow moustache and dark axillary patches.
species.description: Colorado, California, Washington and Baja, in dry open country. Paler and browner than a Peregrine, and the black armpits show clearly from below. Nests on cliff ledges.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, Washington and Baja, in dry open country. Paler and browner than a Peregrine, and the black armpits show clearly from below. Nests on cliff ledges.

species.name: Búho Sabanero
species.short_description: Buff owl with dark wrist patches, hunting low over open ground by day.
species.en_short_description: Buff owl with dark wrist patches, hunting low over open ground by day.
species.description: Every region. Flies with a floppy moth-like action over grassland and marsh at dusk. Ear tufts are tiny and rarely visible. Frequently perches on the ground rather than in trees.
species.en_description: Every region. Flies with a floppy moth-like action over grassland and marsh at dusk. Ear tufts are tiny and rarely visible. Frequently perches on the ground rather than in trees.

species.name: Tecolote Oyamelero Norteño
species.short_description: Very small owl with a large round head, white facial streaks and no ear tufts.
species.en_short_description: Very small owl with a large round head, white facial streaks and no ear tufts.
species.description: Five regions, in dense conifers. Repeats a monotonous single high toot for minutes. Extremely tame when found roosting, which is how most are photographed.
species.en_description: Five regions, in dense conifers. Repeats a monotonous single high toot for minutes. Extremely tame when found roosting, which is how most are photographed.

species.name: Gavilán Pico de Gancho
species.short_description: Broad-winged kite with a heavy deeply hooked bill and paddle-shaped wings.
species.en_short_description: Broad-winged kite with a heavy deeply hooked bill and paddle-shaped wings.
species.description: Mexico City region. The oversized hooked bill is specialised for extracting tree snails. Highly variable plumage. Soars over humid woodland on distinctly paddle-shaped wings.
species.en_description: Mexico City region. The oversized hooked bill is specialised for extracting tree snails. Highly variable plumage. Soars over humid woodland on distinctly paddle-shaped wings.

species.name: Búho Nival
species.short_description: Large white owl with variable dark barring and bright yellow eyes.
species.en_short_description: Large white owl with variable dark barring and bright yellow eyes.
species.description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York in irruption winters only. Sits on the ground, dunes, fenceposts and airport flats. Diurnal. Any record is worth documenting.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York in irruption winters only. Sits on the ground, dunes, fenceposts and airport flats. Diurnal. Any record is worth documenting.

species.name: Aguililla caminera
species.short_description: Small grey-brown hawk with a barred rufous belly, rufous wing patches and yellow eyes.
species.en_short_description: Small grey-brown hawk with a barred rufous belly, rufous wing patches and yellow eyes.
species.description: Mexico City region. Perches low and conspicuously along roads and edges. Noisy, giving a nasal squealing call. Short wings and a long banded tail suit hunting in dense cover.
species.en_description: Mexico City region. Perches low and conspicuously along roads and edges. Noisy, giving a nasal squealing call. Short wings and a long banded tail suit hunting in dense cover.

species.name: Cóndor californiano
species.short_description: Enormous black vulture with white underwing triangles and a bare orange head.
species.en_short_description: Enormous black vulture with white underwing triangles and a bare orange head.
species.description: California only, and one of the rarest birds in the world after a captive-breeding rescue. Nearly three-metre wingspan. Most wild birds carry numbered wing tags, worth recording.
species.en_description: California only, and one of the rarest birds in the world after a captive-breeding rescue. Nearly three-metre wingspan. Most wild birds carry numbered wing tags, worth recording.

species.name: Búho Cara Canela
species.short_description: Slim owl with very long close-set ear tufts and rusty facial discs.
species.en_short_description: Slim owl with very long close-set ear tufts and rusty facial discs.
species.description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York. Roosts communally in dense thickets in winter. Much slimmer than a Great Horned Owl with tufts set close together rather than wide apart.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York. Roosts communally in dense thickets in winter. Much slimmer than a Great Horned Owl with tufts set close together rather than wide apart.

species.name: Tecolote serrano
species.short_description: Tiny long-tailed owl with false eyespots on the back of the head.
species.en_short_description: Tiny long-tailed owl with false eyespots on the back of the head.
species.description: Colorado, California, Washington, Mexico City and Baja. Hunts by day, taking birds its own size. The black nape spots deter mobbing from behind. Gives a steady series of single toots.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, Washington, Mexico City and Baja. Hunts by day, taking birds its own size. The black nape spots deter mobbing from behind. Gives a steady series of single toots.

species.name: Milano de Mississippi
species.short_description: Slender grey kite with a pale head and a black square-tipped tail.
species.en_short_description: Slender grey kite with a pale head and a black square-tipped tail.
species.description: Five regions in summer. Catches insects on the wing with buoyant, effortless flight. Nests in shelterbelts and town trees on the southern plains, including eastern Colorado.
species.en_description: Five regions in summer. Catches insects on the wing with buoyant, effortless flight. Nests in shelterbelts and town trees on the southern plains, including eastern Colorado.

species.name: Gavilán caracolero
species.short_description: Dark kite with a slender deeply hooked bill and a white tail base.
species.en_short_description: Dark kite with a slender deeply hooked bill and a white tail base.
species.description: Mexico City region wetlands. Feeds almost entirely on apple snails, extracted with the fine hooked bill. Flies slowly and low over marsh with the head angled down.
species.en_description: Mexico City region wetlands. Feeds almost entirely on apple snails, extracted with the fine hooked bill. Flies slowly and low over marsh with the head angled down.

species.name: Aguililla Negra Menor
species.short_description: Broad-winged sooty-black hawk with a single broad white tail band and yellow legs.
species.en_short_description: Broad-winged sooty-black hawk with a single broad white tail band and yellow legs.
species.description: Colorado, California, Mexico City and Baja, tied to wooded riparian canyons. Very broad wings give an almost square silhouette. Hunts fish, frogs and crabs along streams.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, Mexico City and Baja, tied to wooded riparian canyons. Very broad wings give an almost square silhouette. Hunts fish, frogs and crabs along streams.

species.name: Tecolote enano
species.short_description: The smallest owl in the region: tiny, grey-brown, with pale eyebrows and yellow eyes.
species.en_short_description: The smallest owl in the region: tiny, grey-brown, with pale eyebrows and yellow eyes.
species.description: California, Mexico City region and Baja. Sparrow-sized and nests in old woodpecker holes in saguaro and riparian trees. Gives a soft chuckling yip. Strictly nocturnal.
species.en_description: California, Mexico City region and Baja. Sparrow-sized and nests in old woodpecker holes in saguaro and riparian trees. Gives a soft chuckling yip. Strictly nocturnal.

species.name: Gavilán Azor Americano
species.short_description: Large powerful accipiter with a bold white eyebrow and grey barred underparts.
species.en_short_description: Large powerful accipiter with a bold white eyebrow and grey barred underparts.
species.description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York, in mature forest. Much bigger and bulkier than Cooper's Hawk, with a strong white supercilium. Fiercely defensive near the nest.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York, in mature forest. Much bigger and bulkier than Cooper's Hawk, with a strong white supercilium. Fiercely defensive near the nest.

species.name: Tecolote Ojos Oscuros
species.short_description: Very small dark-eyed owl with cinnamon flame markings and short ear tufts.
species.en_short_description: Very small dark-eyed owl with cinnamon flame markings and short ear tufts.
species.description: Colorado, California, Washington and central Mexico. The only small owl here with dark rather than yellow eyes. Gives a soft low hoot that carries surprisingly far. Eats almost only insects.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, Washington and central Mexico. The only small owl here with dark rather than yellow eyes. Gives a soft low hoot that carries surprisingly far. Eats almost only insects.

species.name: Aguililla gris
species.short_description: Small neat hawk with finely grey-barred underparts and a boldly banded tail.
species.en_short_description: Small neat hawk with finely grey-barred underparts and a boldly banded tail.
species.description: California, Mexico City region and Baja, in riparian woodland. Compact and accipiter-like in flight. Hunts lizards from a concealed perch. Distinctive whistled descending call.
species.en_description: California, Mexico City region and Baja, in riparian woodland. Compact and accipiter-like in flight. Hunts lizards from a concealed perch. Distinctive whistled descending call.

species.name: cárabo lapón
species.short_description: Huge grey owl with concentric facial rings, a white bow-tie throat and yellow eyes.
species.en_short_description: Huge grey owl with concentric facial rings, a white bow-tie throat and yellow eyes.
species.description: California, Washington and New York, rare and localised. The largest owl here by length though lighter than a Great Horned. Hunts voles by sound, plunging through snow.
species.en_description: California, Washington and New York, rare and localised. The largest owl here by length though lighter than a Great Horned. Hunts voles by sound, plunging through snow.

species.name: Aguililla cola corta
species.short_description: Small buteo in light or dark morphs, with a short banded tail, that hunts on the wing.
species.en_short_description: Small buteo in light or dark morphs, with a short banded tail, that hunts on the wing.
species.description: Mexico City region and Baja. Soars high and stoops on birds from above, unusual for a buteo. Dark morph birds are uniformly sooty with pale wing linings.
species.en_description: Mexico City region and Baja. Soars high and stoops on birds from above, unusual for a buteo. Dark morph birds are uniformly sooty with pale wing linings.

species.name: Halcón Gerifalte
species.short_description: The largest falcon: bulky, broad-winged, in white, grey or dark morphs.
species.en_short_description: The largest falcon: bulky, broad-winged, in white, grey or dark morphs.
species.description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York as a rare winter visitor. Heavier and broader-winged than a Peregrine with a weaker moustache mark. Any record is significant.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York as a rare winter visitor. Heavier and broader-winged than a Peregrine with a weaker moustache mark. Any record is significant.

species.name: Ánade azulón
species.short_description: Familiar dabbling duck; drakes with a glossy green head and white neck ring.
species.en_short_description: Familiar dabbling duck; drakes with a glossy green head and white neck ring.
species.description: The most-observed duck in all six regions and the ancestor of domestic ducks, so odd-plumaged hybrids are common on city ponds. Hens are mottled brown with an orange-and-black bill. Both show a blue wing patch.
species.en_description: The most-observed duck in all six regions and the ancestor of domestic ducks, so odd-plumaged hybrids are common on city ponds. Hens are mottled brown with an orange-and-black bill. Both show a blue wing patch.

species.name: Ganso Canadiense Mayor
species.short_description: Large brown goose with a black head and neck and a broad white chin strap.
species.en_short_description: Large brown goose with a black head and neck and a broad white chin strap.
species.description: Five regions, resident year-round on lawns, golf courses and reservoirs. Flies in noisy V-formations. The white chinstrap on a black head is unmistakable. Aggressive when goslings are present.
species.en_description: Five regions, resident year-round on lawns, golf courses and reservoirs. Flies in noisy V-formations. The white chinstrap on a black head is unmistakable. Aggressive when goslings are present.

species.name: Pato cucharón norteño
species.short_description: Dabbling duck with an enormous spatulate bill; drakes green-headed with white breast and rusty flanks.
species.en_short_description: Dabbling duck with an enormous spatulate bill; drakes green-headed with white breast and rusty flanks.
species.description: Every region. The oversized bill filters plankton from the surface, and groups often swim in tight rotating circles to stir up food. Sits low in the water with the bill angled down.
species.en_description: Every region. The oversized bill filters plankton from the surface, and groups often swim in tight rotating circles to stir up food. Sits low in the water with the bill angled down.

species.name: pato tepalcate
species.short_description: Small chunky diving duck; breeding drakes rich chestnut with a sky-blue bill and white cheeks.
species.en_short_description: Small chunky diving duck; breeding drakes rich chestnut with a sky-blue bill and white cheeks.
species.description: Every region. Cocks its stiff tail vertically like a wren. Winter drakes are dull grey-brown but keep the white cheek. Dives rather than dabbles and rarely comes ashore.
species.en_description: Every region. Cocks its stiff tail vertically like a wren. Winter drakes are dull grey-brown but keep the white cheek. Dives rather than dabbles and rarely comes ashore.

species.name: Cerceta canela
species.short_description: Small teal; drakes uniformly deep cinnamon-red with a red eye.
species.en_short_description: Small teal; drakes uniformly deep cinnamon-red with a red eye.
species.description: Every region, most numerous in the West and Mexico. The plain rusty drake is unlike any other duck. Females are drab brown and hard to separate from Blue-winged Teal.
species.en_description: Every region, most numerous in the West and Mexico. The plain rusty drake is unlike any other duck. Females are drab brown and hard to separate from Blue-winged Teal.

species.name: Pato chalcuán
species.short_description: Medium duck; drakes with a white forecrown and a broad green head band.
species.en_short_description: Medium duck; drakes with a white forecrown and a broad green head band.
species.description: Every region. The white crown gives the old name baldpate. Grazes on grass away from water more than most ducks. Drakes give a distinctive three-note breathy whistle.
species.en_description: Every region. The white crown gives the old name baldpate. Grazes on grass away from water more than most ducks. Drakes give a distinctive three-note breathy whistle.

species.name: Ánade rabudo
species.short_description: Elegant slender duck; drakes with a chocolate head, white neck stripe and long black tail pins.
species.en_short_description: Elegant slender duck; drakes with a chocolate head, white neck stripe and long black tail pins.
species.description: Every region. The most graceful of the dabblers, with a long neck and pointed tail. Hens are slim and plain with a grey bill, still recognisable by shape alone.
species.en_description: Every region. The most graceful of the dabblers, with a long neck and pointed tail. Hens are slim and plain with a grey bill, still recognisable by shape alone.

species.name: Cerceta Alas Azules
species.short_description: Small teal; drakes with a slate head and a bold white facial crescent.
species.en_short_description: Small teal; drakes with a slate head and a bold white facial crescent.
species.description: Every region. The white crescent in front of the eye is the field mark. Shows a blue upper wing patch in flight. One of the latest-arriving and earliest-departing migrants.
species.en_description: Every region. The white crescent in front of the eye is the field mark. Shows a blue upper wing patch in flight. One of the latest-arriving and earliest-departing migrants.

species.name: Pato mexicano
species.short_description: Mallard relative in which both sexes look like a dark hen Mallard.
species.en_short_description: Mallard relative in which both sexes look like a dark hen Mallard.
species.description: Colorado, California and central Mexico. Both sexes are uniformly dark brown; the drake has a plain olive-yellow bill. Hybridises with Mallard, so bill colour and tail pattern matter.
species.en_description: Colorado, California and central Mexico. Both sexes are uniformly dark brown; the drake has a plain olive-yellow bill. Hybridises with Mallard, so bill colour and tail pattern matter.

species.name: Pato Boludo Menor
species.short_description: Diving duck; drakes with a black front, white flanks and a peaked purple-glossed head.
species.en_short_description: Diving duck; drakes with a black front, white flanks and a peaked purple-glossed head.
species.description: Every region. The head peaks toward the back of the crown, unlike the rounded Greater Scaup. Forms large winter rafts on reservoirs and bays. Bill has a small black nail.
species.en_description: Every region. The head peaks toward the back of the crown, unlike the rounded Greater Scaup. Forms large winter rafts on reservoirs and bays. Bill has a small black nail.

species.name: Pato monja
species.short_description: Tiny diving duck; drakes black-and-white with a huge white patch on a puffy dark head.
species.en_short_description: Tiny diving duck; drakes black-and-white with a huge white patch on a puffy dark head.
species.description: Every region. The smallest diving duck here, and it dives almost constantly. Nests in old flicker cavities. Females are dark with a neat white cheek stripe.
species.en_description: Every region. The smallest diving duck here, and it dives almost constantly. Nests in old flicker cavities. Females are dark with a neat white cheek stripe.

species.name: Cerceta Alas Verdes
species.short_description: The smallest dabbling duck; drakes with a chestnut head, green eye patch and a vertical white bar.
species.en_short_description: The smallest dabbling duck; drakes with a chestnut head, green eye patch and a vertical white bar.
species.description: Every region. Compact and fast-flying in tight twisting flocks. The vertical white shoulder stripe separates the American form from Eurasian birds. Feeds on exposed mudflats.
species.en_description: Every region. Compact and fast-flying in tight twisting flocks. The vertical white shoulder stripe separates the American form from Eurasian birds. Feeds on exposed mudflats.

species.name: Pato friso
species.short_description: Understated grey duck; drakes with a black rear end and a white wing patch.
species.en_short_description: Understated grey duck; drakes with a black rear end and a white wing patch.
species.description: Every region. Easy to overlook, but the crisp black stern and the small white square on the wing are diagnostic. Bill is dark and squared. Often dabbles alongside coots.
species.en_description: Every region. Easy to overlook, but the crisp black stern and the small white square on the wing are diagnostic. Bill is dark and squared. Often dabbles alongside coots.

species.name: Pato pico anillado
species.short_description: Diving duck; drakes black-fronted with a peaked head and a bold white ring on the bill.
species.en_short_description: Diving duck; drakes black-fronted with a peaked head and a bold white ring on the bill.
species.description: Every region. Named for a faint neck ring that is nearly invisible; the white bill ring is what you actually see. Prefers wooded ponds over open water.
species.en_description: Every region. Named for a faint neck ring that is nearly invisible; the white bill ring is what you actually see. Prefers wooded ponds over open water.

species.name: Pato Arcoíris
species.short_description: Ornate crested duck; drakes iridescent green and chestnut with bold white facial lines.
species.en_short_description: Ornate crested duck; drakes iridescent green and chestnut with bold white facial lines.
species.description: Every region. Arguably the most spectacular North American duck. Nests in tree cavities, and ducklings leap from the hole to the ground. Perches readily in branches.
species.en_description: Every region. Arguably the most spectacular North American duck. Nests in tree cavities, and ducklings leap from the hole to the ground. Perches readily in branches.

species.name: Mergo cresta blanca
species.short_description: Slim fish-eating duck; drakes with a huge fan-shaped white-and-black crest.
species.en_short_description: Slim fish-eating duck; drakes with a huge fan-shaped white-and-black crest.
species.description: Five regions on wooded ponds and rivers. Thin serrated bill for gripping fish. The crest can be raised into a broad white fan or collapsed to a shaggy line.
species.en_description: Five regions on wooded ponds and rivers. Thin serrated bill for gripping fish. The crest can be raised into a broad white fan or collapsed to a shaggy line.

species.name: Mergo mayor
species.short_description: Large slender fish duck; drakes with a dark green head, white body and red bill.
species.en_short_description: Large slender fish duck; drakes with a dark green head, white body and red bill.
species.description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York, on clear rivers and lakes. Females have a rusty head with a sharp white chin. Flies low and fast in a line along the water.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York, on clear rivers and lakes. Females have a rusty head with a sharp white chin. Flies low and fast in a line along the water.

species.name: Porrón osculado
species.short_description: Compact diving duck; drakes with a dark green head, golden eye and a round white cheek spot.
species.en_short_description: Compact diving duck; drakes with a dark green head, golden eye and a round white cheek spot.
species.description: Five regions. The circular white cheek patch separates it from Barrow's crescent. Wings whistle audibly in flight, giving the old name whistler. Nests in tree cavities.
species.en_description: Five regions. The circular white cheek patch separates it from Barrow's crescent. Wings whistle audibly in flight, giving the old name whistler. Nests in tree cavities.

species.name: Pato Cabeza Roja
species.short_description: Diving duck; drakes with a rounded brick-red head, black breast and grey back.
species.en_short_description: Diving duck; drakes with a rounded brick-red head, black breast and grey back.
species.description: Every region. Rounder-headed and paler-backed than the Canvasback, with a grey rather than black bill tip. Gathers in large rafts on open water in winter.
species.en_description: Every region. Rounder-headed and paler-backed than the Canvasback, with a grey rather than black bill tip. Gathers in large rafts on open water in winter.

species.name: Ganso de collar
species.short_description: Small dark sea goose with a black head and a small white neck flash.
species.en_short_description: Small dark sea goose with a black head and a small white neck flash.
species.description: Five regions, on coastal bays where it feeds on eelgrass. Much smaller and darker than a Canada Goose, with a narrow necklace rather than a chinstrap. Rarely inland.
species.en_description: Five regions, on coastal bays where it feeds on eelgrass. Much smaller and darker than a Canada Goose, with a narrow necklace rather than a chinstrap. Rarely inland.

species.name: Negreta nuca blanca
species.short_description: Bulky black sea duck; drakes with bold white head patches and a swollen orange bill.
species.en_short_description: Bulky black sea duck; drakes with bold white head patches and a swollen orange bill.
species.description: Five regions on coastal water. The white forehead and nape patches earn it the name skunk-head. Dives through breaking surf for mussels. Winter flocks are large and close inshore.
species.en_description: Five regions on coastal water. The white forehead and nape patches earn it the name skunk-head. Dives through breaking surf for mussels. Winter flocks are large and close inshore.

species.name: Mergo copetón
species.short_description: Slim sea duck with a spiky double crest and a thin red bill.
species.en_short_description: Slim sea duck with a spiky double crest and a thin red bill.
species.description: Every region, mostly on salt water. Shaggier-crested and greyer-flanked than the Common Merganser. Hunts fish cooperatively in shallow bays, sometimes driving them into the shallows.
species.en_description: Every region, mostly on salt water. Shaggier-crested and greyer-flanked than the Common Merganser. Hunts fish cooperatively in shallow bays, sometimes driving them into the shallows.

species.name: Ganso blanco
species.short_description: White goose with black wingtips and a pink bill with a dark grinning patch.
species.en_short_description: White goose with black wingtips and a pink bill with a dark grinning patch.
species.description: Five regions, in enormous noisy flocks on migration. A dark blue morph also occurs and was once thought a separate species. Grubs up roots, leaving fields churned bare.
species.en_description: Five regions, in enormous noisy flocks on migration. A dark blue morph also occurs and was once thought a separate species. Grubs up roots, leaving fields churned bare.

species.name: Cisne mudo
species.short_description: Very large white swan with an orange bill and a black basal knob, neck held in a curve.
species.en_short_description: Very large white swan with an orange bill and a black basal knob, neck held in a curve.
species.description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York. Introduced and now feral, especially in the north-east. Holds its neck in an S-curve with the bill angled down, unlike native swans.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York. Introduced and now feral, especially in the north-east. Holds its neck in an S-curve with the bill angled down, unlike native swans.

species.name: Ánsar careto
species.short_description: Grey-brown goose with a white blaze at the bill base and black belly bars.
species.en_short_description: Grey-brown goose with a white blaze at the bill base and black belly bars.
species.description: Five regions. The white forehead patch and irregular black barring on the belly are diagnostic. Bill and legs are orange. Gives a distinctive high yelping laugh in flight.
species.en_description: Five regions. The white forehead patch and irregular black barring on the belly are diagnostic. Bill and legs are orange. Gives a distinctive high yelping laugh in flight.

species.name: Barnacla canadiense chica
species.short_description: Miniature version of the Canada Goose, with a stubby bill and rounder head.
species.en_short_description: Miniature version of the Canada Goose, with a stubby bill and rounder head.
species.description: Five regions. Split from the Canada Goose and roughly Mallard-sized, with a proportionally much shorter bill and steeper forehead. Often mixed into large Canada Goose flocks.
species.en_description: Five regions. Split from the Canada Goose and roughly Mallard-sized, with a proportionally much shorter bill and steeper forehead. Often mixed into large Canada Goose flocks.

species.name: Pijije Alas Blancas
species.short_description: Long-legged duck with a coral-red bill, chestnut breast and black belly.
species.en_short_description: Long-legged duck with a coral-red bill, chestnut breast and black belly.
species.description: Five regions and expanding north. Perches in trees and on wires, and gives a high whistling call rather than a quack. Bold white wing stripe shows clearly in flight.
species.en_description: Five regions and expanding north. Perches in trees and on wires, and gives a high whistling call rather than a quack. Bold white wing stripe shows clearly in flight.

species.name: Pato Boludo Mayor
species.short_description: Diving duck; drakes with a rounded green-glossed head and clean white flanks.
species.en_short_description: Diving duck; drakes with a rounded green-glossed head and clean white flanks.
species.description: Five regions, more coastal than the Lesser Scaup. The head is evenly rounded with a green rather than purple gloss, and the white wing stripe extends further toward the tip.
species.en_description: Five regions, more coastal than the Lesser Scaup. The head is evenly rounded with a green rather than purple gloss, and the white wing stripe extends further toward the tip.

species.name: Porrón islándico
species.short_description: Goldeneye with a purple-glossed head and a white crescent, not a circle, on the cheek.
species.en_short_description: Goldeneye with a purple-glossed head and a white crescent, not a circle, on the cheek.
species.description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York, favouring mountain lakes. The crescent-shaped cheek mark and stubbier bill separate it from the Common Goldeneye.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York, favouring mountain lakes. The crescent-shaped cheek mark and stubbier bill separate it from the Common Goldeneye.

species.name: Pato coacoxtle
species.short_description: Large diving duck with a sloping black bill and a wedge-shaped rusty head.
species.en_short_description: Large diving duck with a sloping black bill and a wedge-shaped rusty head.
species.description: Every region. The long sloping forehead and all-dark bill give a distinctive profile. Back is nearly white in drakes, much paler than a Redhead's grey.
species.en_description: Every region. The long sloping forehead and all-dark bill give a distinctive profile. Back is nearly white in drakes, much paler than a Redhead's grey.

species.name: Cisne trompetero
species.short_description: Very large all-white swan with an all-black bill and a straight neck.
species.en_short_description: Very large all-white swan with an all-black bill and a straight neck.
species.description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York. The heaviest native waterfowl. Bill is entirely black with no yellow, and the call is a deep resonant trumpet rather than a whistle.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York. The heaviest native waterfowl. Bill is entirely black with no yellow, and the call is a deep resonant trumpet rather than a whistle.

species.name: Pato arlequín
species.short_description: Small sea duck; drakes slate-blue with bold white crescents and chestnut flanks.
species.en_short_description: Small sea duck; drakes slate-blue with bold white crescents and chestnut flanks.
species.description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York. Breeds on fast mountain streams and winters on rocky surf-swept coasts. The intricate white harness pattern is unmistakable.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York. Breeds on fast mountain streams and winters on rocky surf-swept coasts. The intricate white harness pattern is unmistakable.

species.name: Pato havelda
species.short_description: Sea duck with a pied plumage that changes seasonally; drakes with very long tail feathers.
species.en_short_description: Sea duck with a pied plumage that changes seasonally; drakes with very long tail feathers.
species.description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York. Uniquely among ducks it has three distinct annual plumages. Dives extremely deep. Calls a musical yodelling ow-ow-owdle-ow.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York. Uniquely among ducks it has three distinct annual plumages. Dives extremely deep. Calls a musical yodelling ow-ow-owdle-ow.

species.name: Pato negro americano
species.short_description: Dark sooty-brown dabbler with a violet wing patch and bright orange-red legs.
species.en_short_description: Dark sooty-brown dabbler with a violet wing patch and bright orange-red legs.
species.description: Colorado, New York and Washington. Both sexes resemble a very dark hen Mallard but with sharply contrasting pale head and dark body. Hybridises freely with Mallard.
species.en_description: Colorado, New York and Washington. Both sexes resemble a very dark hen Mallard but with sharply contrasting pale head and dark body. Hybridises freely with Mallard.

species.name: Pato silbón
species.short_description: Wigeon with a rufous head and a creamy-yellow forecrown stripe.
species.en_short_description: Wigeon with a rufous head and a creamy-yellow forecrown stripe.
species.description: Five regions as a scarce visitor among American Wigeon flocks. The chestnut head with a buff crown replaces the American's white forehead and green band. Grey flanks, not pinkish.
species.en_description: Five regions as a scarce visitor among American Wigeon flocks. The chestnut head with a buff crown replaces the American's white forehead and green band. Grey flanks, not pinkish.

species.name: Cisne de tundra
species.short_description: Large white swan with a black bill usually showing a small yellow spot at the base.
species.en_short_description: Large white swan with a black bill usually showing a small yellow spot at the base.
species.description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York. Smaller than a Trumpeter with a more rounded head and a higher-pitched whooping call. Migrates in long high skeins.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York. Smaller than a Trumpeter with a more rounded head and a higher-pitched whooping call. Migrates in long high skeins.

species.name: negrón aliblanco
species.short_description: Heavy black sea duck; drakes with a white eye comma and a white wing patch.
species.en_short_description: Heavy black sea duck; drakes with a white eye comma and a white wing patch.
species.description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York. The white speculum often shows only in flight or when the bird stretches. Bill has a swollen knob and a pale tip.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York. The white speculum often shows only in flight or when the bird stretches. Bill has a swollen knob and a pale tip.

species.name: Negreta Pico Amarillo
species.short_description: Chunky sea duck; drakes wholly black with a bulbous bright orange-yellow bill knob.
species.en_short_description: Chunky sea duck; drakes wholly black with a bulbous bright orange-yellow bill knob.
species.description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York. The yellow bill knob against a matte black head is the field mark. Females are dark with pale cheeks. Gives a mournful whistling call.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, Washington and New York. The yellow bill knob against a matte black head is the field mark. Females are dark with pale cheeks. Gives a mournful whistling call.

species.name: Ánsar de Ross
species.short_description: Small white goose with black wingtips and a short stubby bill without a grin patch.
species.en_short_description: Small white goose with black wingtips and a short stubby bill without a grin patch.
species.description: Five regions, usually a few birds within Snow Goose flocks. Noticeably smaller with a rounder head and a much shorter bill that lacks the Snow Goose's dark grinning line.
species.en_description: Five regions, usually a few birds within Snow Goose flocks. Noticeably smaller with a rounder head and a much shorter bill that lacks the Snow Goose's dark grinning line.

species.name: Éider común
species.short_description: Very large sea duck; drakes white above and black below with a green nape wash.
species.en_short_description: Very large sea duck; drakes white above and black below with a green nape wash.
species.description: California, New York and Washington coasts. The bulkiest duck here, with a long sloping wedge-shaped bill. Females are richly barred brown. Down from the nest is legendary insulation.
species.en_description: California, New York and Washington coasts. The bulkiest duck here, with a long sloping wedge-shaped bill. Females are richly barred brown. Down from the nest is legendary insulation.

species.name: Mapache
species.short_description: Grey bandit-masked mammal with a black-ringed tail and dexterous hands.
species.en_short_description: Grey bandit-masked mammal with a black-ringed tail and dexterous hands.
species.description: The most-observed small mammal across all six regions, equally at home in Mexico City parks and Seattle alleys. Hand-like front prints beside water are a reliable sign. Largely nocturnal but bold by day in cities.
species.en_description: The most-observed small mammal across all six regions, equally at home in Mexico City parks and Seattle alleys. Hand-like front prints beside water are a reliable sign. Largely nocturnal but bold by day in cities.

species.name: Conejo serrano
species.short_description: Brown rabbit with a rusty nape and a white puff of a tail.
species.en_short_description: Brown rabbit with a rusty nape and a white puff of a tail.
species.description: The common rabbit of New York, Colorado's plains and central Mexico. Freezes rather than flees, then breaks into a zig-zag run. Feeds on lawns and field edges at dawn and dusk.
species.en_description: The common rabbit of New York, Colorado's plains and central Mexico. Freezes rather than flees, then breaks into a zig-zag run. Feeds on lawns and field edges at dawn and dusk.

species.name: Liebre cola negra
species.short_description: Very large hare with enormous black-edged ears and a black-topped tail.
species.en_short_description: Very large hare with enormous black-edged ears and a black-topped tail.
species.description: Open country from Colorado to Baja. A hare, not a rabbit: young are born furred and open-eyed. Runs in long low bounds with occasional high spy-hops to look around.
species.en_description: Open country from Colorado to Baja. A hare, not a rabbit: young are born furred and open-eyed. Runs in long low bounds with occasional high spy-hops to look around.

species.name: Conejo del desierto
species.short_description: Pale sandy cottontail with proportionally large ears, in arid scrub.
species.en_short_description: Pale sandy cottontail with proportionally large ears, in arid scrub.
species.description: Dry country in Colorado, California and Baja California Sur. Bigger-eared and paler than the Eastern Cottontail, which suits desert heat. Shelters in burrows and under cholla by day.
species.en_description: Dry country in Colorado, California and Baja California Sur. Bigger-eared and paler than the Eastern Cottontail, which suits desert heat. Shelters in burrows and under cholla by day.

species.name: Pica Americana
species.short_description: Small round-eared, tailless relative of rabbits, living in high alpine talus.
species.en_short_description: Small round-eared, tailless relative of rabbits, living in high alpine talus.
species.description: Colorado, Sierra and Cascade boulder fields above treeline. Gives a sharp bleating call from a rock. Cures haypiles of vegetation for winter rather than hibernating — the haypiles are easy to spot.
species.en_description: Colorado, Sierra and Cascade boulder fields above treeline. Gives a sharp bleating call from a rock. Cures haypiles of vegetation for winter rather than hibernating — the haypiles are easy to spot.

species.name: Cacomixtle norteño
species.short_description: Slender fox-faced carnivore with huge eyes and a long boldly black-and-white banded tail.
species.en_short_description: Slender fox-faced carnivore with huge eyes and a long boldly black-and-white banded tail.
species.description: Rocky canyons from Colorado through Mexico City to the Baja cape. Strictly nocturnal and superbly agile, able to rotate its hind feet to descend cliffs headfirst. Related to raccoons, not cats.
species.en_description: Rocky canyons from Colorado through Mexico City to the Baja cape. Strictly nocturnal and superbly agile, able to rotate its hind feet to descend cliffs headfirst. Related to raccoons, not cats.

species.name: Zorrillo listado norteño
species.short_description: Black skunk with a white crown stripe forking into two stripes down the back.
species.en_short_description: Black skunk with a white crown stripe forking into two stripes down the back.
species.description: Common in Colorado, California, Washington and New York, including suburbs. Stamps its front feet and raises its tail as a warning before spraying. Digs small conical pits in lawns hunting grubs.
species.en_description: Common in Colorado, California, Washington and New York, including suburbs. Stamps its front feet and raises its tail as a warning before spraying. Digs small conical pits in lawns hunting grubs.

species.name: Nutria de río norteamericana
species.short_description: Long sleek dark aquatic mustelid with a thick tapering tail, often in family groups.
species.en_short_description: Long sleek dark aquatic mustelid with a thick tapering tail, often in family groups.
species.description: Rivers, lakes and estuaries across the four US regions, recovering strongly. Swims with head and back showing, unlike a beaver's broad wake. Slides on mud and snow banks, leaving distinctive chutes.
species.en_description: Rivers, lakes and estuaries across the four US regions, recovering strongly. Swims with head and back showing, unlike a beaver's broad wake. Slides on mud and snow banks, leaving distinctive chutes.

species.name: Conejo matorralero
species.short_description: Small dark cottontail with short ears and a small inconspicuous tail.
species.en_short_description: Small dark cottontail with short ears and a small inconspicuous tail.
species.description: California chaparral and coastal scrub. Smaller, darker and shorter-eared than any other cottontail, and rarely ventures far from dense brush. Uses well-worn tunnels through the thicket.
species.en_description: California chaparral and coastal scrub. Smaller, darker and shorter-eared than any other cottontail, and rarely ventures far from dense brush. Uses well-worn tunnels through the thicket.

species.name: Visón americano
species.short_description: Slim dark chocolate-brown mustelid with a white chin patch, always near water.
species.en_short_description: Slim dark chocolate-brown mustelid with a white chin patch, always near water.
species.description: Streams and marshes in all four US regions. Longer and lower than a squirrel, and much darker than a weasel in summer. Hunts along banks and swims readily; largely nocturnal.
species.en_description: Streams and marshes in all four US regions. Longer and lower than a squirrel, and much darker than a weasel in summer. Hunts along banks and swims readily; largely nocturnal.

species.name: Comadreja cola larga
species.short_description: Slender tan weasel with a black-tipped tail nearly half its body length.
species.en_short_description: Slender tan weasel with a black-tipped tail nearly half its body length.
species.description: Present in five regions. Turns white in winter in the north but keeps the black tail tip, which is the key mark. Bounds with an arched back and hunts rodents in their own burrows.
species.en_description: Present in five regions. Turns white in winter in the north but keeps the black tail tip, which is the key mark. Bounds with an arched back and hunts rodents in their own burrows.

species.name: Liebre americana
species.short_description: Medium hare with very large hind feet, brown in summer and white in winter.
species.en_short_description: Medium hare with very large hind feet, brown in summer and white in winter.
species.description: Dense conifer and willow thickets in Colorado, the Cascades and the Adirondacks. The oversized hind feet act as snowshoes. Moulting animals in patchy brown-and-white are a common spring sight.
species.en_description: Dense conifer and willow thickets in Colorado, the Cascades and the Adirondacks. The oversized hind feet act as snowshoes. Moulting animals in patchy brown-and-white are a common spring sight.

species.name: Conejo de montaña
species.short_description: Pale grey-brown cottontail with short rounded ears, in sagebrush and mountain shrub.
species.en_short_description: Pale grey-brown cottontail with short rounded ears, in sagebrush and mountain shrub.
species.description: Colorado, eastern California and Washington uplands. Shorter-eared than the Desert Cottontail and greyer than the Eastern. Favours rocky sagebrush slopes and aspen edges.
species.en_description: Colorado, eastern California and Washington uplands. Shorter-eared than the Desert Cottontail and greyer than the Eastern. Favours rocky sagebrush slopes and aspen edges.

species.name: Tlalcoyote
species.short_description: Low, wide, grizzled digger with a white stripe over the head and black facial patches.
species.en_short_description: Low, wide, grizzled digger with a white stripe over the head and black facial patches.
species.description: Open country in five regions. Unmistakably flattened in profile with enormous foreclaws. Leaves large elliptical burrow entrances with a fan of soil. Mostly nocturnal and formidable if cornered.
species.en_description: Open country in five regions. Unmistakably flattened in profile with enormous foreclaws. Leaves large elliptical burrow entrances with a fan of soil. Mostly nocturnal and formidable if cornered.

species.name: Musaraña de cola corta del Norte
species.short_description: Slate-grey shrew with a very short tail and tiny eyes; venomous saliva.
species.en_short_description: Slate-grey shrew with a very short tail and tiny eyes; venomous saliva.
species.description: Woodland leaf litter and gardens in New York. One of the few venomous mammals, using it to subdue prey. Far more often found dead on a path than seen alive.
species.en_description: Woodland leaf litter and gardens in New York. One of the few venomous mammals, using it to subdue prey. Far more often found dead on a path than seen alive.

species.name: Murciélago orejón californiano
species.short_description: Large-eared desert bat with an upright triangular nose-leaf.
species.en_short_description: Large-eared desert bat with an upright triangular nose-leaf.
species.description: Desert caves and mines in southern California and Baja California Sur. The nose-leaf and huge ears are diagnostic. Hovers to pluck insects from foliage rather than hawking in open air.
species.en_description: Desert caves and mines in southern California and Baja California Sur. The nose-leaf and huge ears are diagnostic. Hovers to pluck insects from foliage rather than hawking in open air.

species.name: Zorrillo manchado occidental
species.short_description: Small skunk broken into white spots and broken stripes rather than long lines.
species.en_short_description: Small skunk broken into white spots and broken stripes rather than long lines.
species.description: Colorado, California, Washington and Baja. Performs a handstand on its front legs as a threat display before spraying — unique among skunks. More agile and more nocturnal than the Striped Skunk.
species.en_description: Colorado, California, Washington and Baja. Performs a handstand on its front legs as a threat display before spraying — unique among skunks. More agile and more nocturnal than the Striped Skunk.

species.name: Marta costera
species.short_description: Cat-sized golden-brown mustelid with a bushy tail and orange throat patch.
species.en_short_description: Cat-sized golden-brown mustelid with a bushy tail and orange throat patch.
species.description: Old conifer forest in Colorado, the Sierra and the Cascades. Climbs and hunts squirrels in the canopy. The bright throat bib against dark legs is the field mark; tracks bound in pairs through snow.
species.en_description: Old conifer forest in Colorado, the Sierra and the Cascades. Climbs and hunts squirrels in the canopy. The bright throat bib against dark legs is the field mark; tracks bound in pairs through snow.

species.name: Nutria marina
species.short_description: Thick-furred marine otter that floats on its back, often with a rock on its chest.
species.en_short_description: Thick-furred marine otter that floats on its back, often with a rock on its chest.
species.description: Kelp forests off California and Washington. Rafts of animals wrapped in kelp fronds are the classic sighting. Uses stones as tools to crack urchins and abalone — visible and audible from shore.
species.en_description: Kelp forests off California and Washington. Rafts of animals wrapped in kelp fronds are the classic sighting. Uses stones as tools to crack urchins and abalone — visible and audible from shore.

species.name: Murciélago desértico norteño
species.short_description: Large pale bat with big translucent ears and a blunt piglike snout.
species.en_short_description: Large pale bat with big translucent ears and a blunt piglike snout.
species.description: Arid country in Colorado, California, Washington and Baja. Gleans scorpions and crickets from the ground rather than catching insects in flight. Roosts in rock crevices and building eaves.
species.en_description: Arid country in Colorado, California, Washington and Baja. Gleans scorpions and crickets from the ground rather than catching insects in flight. Roosts in rock crevices and building eaves.

species.name: Topo Musaraña Americano
species.short_description: Tiny dark mole with a short hairy tail; the smallest North American mole.
species.en_short_description: Tiny dark mole with a short hairy tail; the smallest North American mole.
species.description: Damp forest floor and stream banks in California and Washington. Unlike other moles it forages above ground in leaf litter and even climbs low vegetation, so it is occasionally seen alive.
species.en_description: Damp forest floor and stream banks in California and Washington. Unlike other moles it forages above ground in leaf litter and even climbs low vegetation, so it is occasionally seen alive.

species.name: murciélago moreno norteamericano
species.short_description: Robust glossy brown bat with a broad muzzle and black wings.
species.en_short_description: Robust glossy brown bat with a broad muzzle and black wings.
species.description: Present in all six regions and the bat most often found roosting in buildings. Large and slow-flying compared with myotis bats. Often the last bat still hunting on cold autumn evenings.
species.en_description: Present in all six regions and the bat most often found roosting in buildings. Large and slow-flying compared with myotis bats. Often the last bat still hunting on cold autumn evenings.

species.name: Murciélago trompudo
species.short_description: Nectar bat with a long snout, small nose-leaf and a very long extensible tongue.
species.en_short_description: Nectar bat with a long snout, small nose-leaf and a very long extensible tongue.
species.description: Southern California and central Mexico. Feeds at agave and columnar cactus flowers, and readily visits hummingbird feeders at night. Migratory, following bloom northward.
species.en_description: Southern California and central Mexico. Feeds at agave and columnar cactus flowers, and readily visits hummingbird feeders at night. Migratory, following bloom northward.

species.name: marta pescadora
species.short_description: Large dark forest mustelid with a long bushy tail, bigger than a marten.
species.en_short_description: Large dark forest mustelid with a long bushy tail, bigger than a marten.
species.description: Recovering in New York, Washington and reintroduced in California. Roughly house-cat sized but far longer-bodied, and much darker than a marten with no bright throat bib. One of few predators of porcupines.
species.en_description: Recovering in New York, Washington and reintroduced in California. Roughly house-cat sized but far longer-bodied, and much darker than a marten with no bright throat bib. One of few predators of porcupines.

species.name: Murciélago magueyero menor
species.short_description: Nectar-feeding bat with an elongated snout, feeding at cactus and agave blooms.
species.en_short_description: Nectar-feeding bat with an elongated snout, feeding at cactus and agave blooms.
species.description: Mexico City region and Baja California Sur. A key pollinator of saguaro-type cacti and agaves. Migrates along corridors of flowering plants; colonies can number thousands in desert caves.
species.en_description: Mexico City region and Baja California Sur. A key pollinator of saguaro-type cacti and agaves. Migrates along corridors of flowering plants; colonies can number thousands in desert caves.

species.name: Murciélago mexicano cola suelta
species.short_description: Narrow-winged fast bat whose tail extends well beyond the membrane.
species.en_short_description: Narrow-winged fast bat whose tail extends well beyond the membrane.
